label: A judgment of one diagnosis by Claude as a judge (klaxon.judge): a model's, not a rule's or a person's. It saw the right answer and the remedy of the system the diagnosis was made on, and the whole diagnosis; never which model wrote it, nor the rule's verdict. A recorded response, in judge-recording.jsonl.

right_answer.cause: a deploy of the webhook receiver with a rotated secret the provider does not sign with (WEBHOOK_SECRET_VERSION=v2, while the provider signs with v1): every webhook fails its signature check and is refused with a 400, so no event reaches Kafka, and the provider keeps sending them again, with backoff
right_answer.remedy: roll the webhook receiver back to v1 (or accept both versions until the provider signs with v2): the provider sends every refused webhook again, and the books catch up by themselves

judgment.why: It names the webhook-receiver deploy with WEBHOOK_SECRET_VERSION=v2 no longer matching the provider's signing key, so every webhook is refused as bad_signature and none is queued to Kafka while the provider resends, and it rolls the receiver back.
